We are facing a massive population decline and John Thune thinks it’s a good time to shill for pesticide manufacturers. 

For those who don’t know, a lot of the crap they are spraying on our food during farming IS causing cancer… especially in kids. Not to mention the KNOWN impacts on fertility.

The pesticide liability shield needs to STAY OUT of the Farm Bill. Hearing the Senate is trying to add it back in.
Some members of Congress are making millions upon millions in insider trading. It is time to put the legislation to ban insider trading to a vote.

Leader Thune continues to BLOCK the SAVE America Act and now he wants to shield pesticide corporations from liabilities. 

Until Thune removes the filibuster and calls the vote for SAVE America, the House will block every piece of legislation he sends over.

Video
This is how Congress uses your hard earned tax dollars. Believe me, it upsets me just as much as it upsets you.

🚨 Attention Florida 13, applications are now open for Service Academy Nominations! 

If you are a student with aspirations of attending one of our nation’s esteemed service academies and would like to apply for a congressional nomination, please visit Luna.house.gov/service-acade… to apply today.

The only bacon the “Save Our Bacon Act” is actually saving is China’s.

This isn’t just a states’ rights issue or an animal welfare issue, it’s a national security issue. China already controls roughly 25% of the American pork industry. Why would Congress pass legislation that further strengthens Beijing’s grip on America’s food supply?

Video

This week I will be introducing a bill in the House to suspend the federal gas tax in light of Trump’s recent remarks. 

American families need this relief on gas prices. My office will be working directly with President Trump to ensure we deliver this win for the American people.


Nancy Cordes (@nancycordes)

In a phone interview, President Trump told me that he wants to pause the 18 cent federal gas tax “for a period of time.”

“I think it’s a great idea,” he said. “Yup, we’re going to take o

As Chairwoman of the Task Force of the Declassification of Federal Secrets, we have been working overtime to bring declassification of all materials regarding UAP’s and disclosure yet we have been stonewalled by various bureaucratic agencies every step of the way.

This release of the first tranche of documents marks a HUGE step in the right direction and there will be MUCH more to come.

Video

Of all the titles I will have,
Of all the pomp and circumstance,
Being a mom will ALWAYS be the most special thing I will ever experience. 
Happy Mother’s day to all the mommies out there. 
We are sending our 🫶🏻 to you.

I am completely honored that so many people are asking me, floated me, or have said that I would be a great Speaker of the House. Truly, it is wonderful and I am flattered to have that type of support and trust. 

However, I do not know where the rumor started that I was considering a run, as I have never spoken to any member about it or considered even running for Speaker. 

For now, I feel that I am right where I need to be. At any rate, I love and appreciate all of you and will continue to fi
As we come to the end of Teacher Appreciation Week I want to thank all the teachers of FL13 and beyond who are helping to educate, mentor, and inspire the next generation 📚
May is Mental Health Awareness month, and in light of the extreme mental health crisis in America impacting young people online we will be running a campaign to raise awareness 🫶🏼

Virginia Democrats aren’t the only ones about to take a hit 🫖🤣.


DC_Draino (@DC_Draino)

Looks like we may have just won the midterms. 

The Virginia Supreme Court just struck down their gerrymandered map. 

God bless America.

The White House (@WhiteHouse)

PRESIDENTIAL UNSEALING FOR UAP ENCOUNTERS. 

Per President Trump's directive, the @DeptofWar has declassified & released unresolved UAP records. This is an unprecedented level of transparency, no other admin has gone this far.

Files now live on WAR.GOV/UFO — additional files will be released by the Dept. of War on a rolling basis.📂
